fusions.name: Wringing Clasp
fusions.desc: A crushing grip that deals 30 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Grapple Finish
fusions.desc: A grappling hold that deals 22 damage, consumes every affliction on the target and adds 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit, and leaves it [Leaden] for 5 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Steadying Hold
fusions.desc: Sets a firm barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 10 seconds. Your armour rises by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Unslipping Grasp
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 8%. You have 8% earth resistance.
